II. In speciem, moliminis istius opera antecedanea, ei praemittenda, & ad illud viam struentia: judicium nempe per Chaldaeos exsequendum contra Judaeos immorigeros. Ubi describitur
1. Apparatus bellicus, adversus populum rebellem convertendus, cujus notetur
A. Instrumentum, Rex Chaldaeorum cum suo exercitu. verf. 6. 7.
B. Invasio expedita in terram Judaeorum facienda. verf. 8.
C. Fucatum Regis, expeditionem facientis, consilium. verf. 9.
2. Expeditionis ad supplicium populo inferendum successus & eventus. verf. 10.
3. Judicii istius ad justificationem viarum Dei usus & fructus. verf. 11.
main_text.head: EXPOSITIO TEXTUALIS.
main_text.p: Verf. 5. Videte contemptores (vel, in gentibus) & adspicite, & miramini inter vos, & obstupescite; quia opus molior in diebus vestris, quod non credetis, cum enarrabitur.

§. 1. Verba ראו בגוים [?] ab aliis vertuntur adspicite in gentibus, ut legit Hieronymus. Cl. Coccejus spectate gentes, qui addit verbum ראה [?] si cum ב [?] construatur, significare spectare aliquid, Cant. 3: 11. Mich. 7: 10. Verum Lxx legunt καταφρονηταὶ [?] contemptores, spreto-res.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words marked [?] are set small and partly blurred on the scan; the Hebrew vowels and the Greek accents are hard to make out, so I have not reproduced the exact pointing. "faciendai" in item B is uncertain, read as "facienda". The outline items and sub-items are set as paragraphs, not as diagram lines. The running head is taken from the head of the page: "HABAKUK" with "CAP. I: 5-11" beside it.
